title: Investigatory Spotlight: How the Troubled Teen Industry Manages Its Reputation
excerpt: New names for programs with bad histories, thousands of near-identical pages for every town, directories run by the programs' own marketing company, help lines and consultants paid by the programs they recommend, lawsuits against survivors and reporters, and brochures the records contradict: how the troubled teen industry shapes what a parent finds online, from court records, GAO and Senate reports and published reporting.
